summary: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Scarborough Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Council concerning an application by the property owners of 96 Chestnut Crescent for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Section 447-5.C of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner(s) is seeking Council's permission to be exempt concerning an existing wood privacy fence located in the rear yard along the west lot line, which does not comply with restrictions contrary to Section 447-2 of the by-law as detailed below in the following chart: The subject property, 96 Chestnut Crescent, is a two story semi-detached residential dwelling located in Ward 35, in a Residential Semi-Detached Zone, west of Birchmount Road and north of St. Clair Avenue East. Municipal Licensing Standards inspected the Fence and determined it does not comply with Section 447-3 of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences, as detailed in the following chart: GENERAL LOCATION SPECIFIC LOCATION DEFICIENCY BY-LAW SECTION & REQUIREMENT* Rear Yard Fence in the rear yard on the lot line between 96 and 98 Chestnut Crescent Exceeds Permitted Height- of 2.0 meters for 6.8 meters. Requesting a Height of 3.0 meters for 6.8 meters. Section 447-2 (B)(1) Fence on unroofed deck and not in the front or…
decided: Scarborough Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption permit by the property owner of 96 Chestnut Crescent, thereby allowing the fence to remain as constructed; directs and requires that at such time as replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
